description: Greenery and emission sources around a point (a home): tree canopy share within 300 m, green land share and summer NDVI within 500 m with a low/medium/high level against the rest of the city, the nearest park, up to 10 emission sources (power plants and works within 5 km, boiler houses and single chimneys within 1.5 km) with distance, bearing, fuel and confidence, and the number of detached houses within 1 km (an estimate of stove smoke, not a count of stoves). Only computed cities; elsewhere the error city_not_covered.
name: get_home_environment
title: Surroundings of a home
